units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 1:24">Targ. Ez. I, 24</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 1:25">25</cite> ed. Lag. <he>דבי׳</he> (oth. <cite ref="D00471"><he>דבו׳</he></cite>, some ed. <he>די בירא</he>, read <cite ref="D00475"><he>דִּיבֵּירָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 7:89">Targ. Y. Num. VII, 89</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 6a:10">R. Hash. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>אימא ד׳ לא כלום הוא</he> I might have thought a mere word (without action) was of no effect.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 6a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>לא קיימיה לדִיבּוּרֵיה</he> he did not substantiate his word (by an action).
Ned. 41ᵃ ד׳ קשי וכ׳ talking is injurious to the eyes; a. fr.—Pl. דִּיבּוּרַיָּא, דְּבִירַיָּא, דִּיבֵּירַיָּא, דִּבּ׳, esp. the Ten Commandments.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 20:1">Targ. Y. Ex. XX, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 2:25">II</cite> <he>דִּיבְרַיָּא</he>); a. fr.—Y. Meg. IV, 75ᵇ bot. <he>קטע בריבי׳ וכ׳</he> cut the Ten Commandments apart, so that our children may be able to study them.
